description: List calendar days in the look-ahead window that have no attendable shift yet, plus recurring monthly slots not yet claimed by a schedule — i.e. where the account still needs volunteers. Requires the `read` scope.

current_year_only.description: When true (the default), clamp the window to the end of the current calendar year instead of crossing into next year.

months.description: How many months to look ahead (1–24). Default 12.

name: get_open_days
title: Get open days (who do we still need?)
